verdict.rationale: Sentry is a monitoring platform, so SLO definition with error budgets and burn-rate alerting is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only documents rule-based issue alerts and health dashboards. Nothing mentions SLO objects, error-budget tracking, or burn-rate alert conditions, and generic alerts and dashboards are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
